description: This file defines application-wide constants for preference keys and configuration, particularly for a Flutter app. It includes string constants for preference keys and a numeric constant for fare rate, all encapsulated within the AppConstants class. These constants mirror keys from a Kotlin application's SharedPreferences setup.

classes.name: AppConstants
classes.description: A class containing static constants for preference keys and configuration settings used across the application. It includes string constants for preference keys like login status, display name, Google account info, language preferences, and a numeric fare rate constant.

methods.description: A private constructor to prevent instantiation of the AppConstants class, effectively making it a namespace for constants.
